item.description: Summary Deploying a Blazor Server-Side application to IIS can seem daunting, but with the right steps, it becomes a straightforward task. item.title: Why is OnInitializedAsync() Called Twice on Page Reload in .NET 8 Blazor?
item.description: Why is OnInitializedAsync() Called Twice on Page Reload in .NET 8 Blazor? In Blazor, particularly when using RenderMode.InteractiveServer, you might notice that OnInitializedAsync() gets called twice during a page reload. This behavior can be perplexing, especially when it causes unnecessary database queries or other repeated operations. Let’s dive into why this happens and explore different strategies to manage it effectively. Summary When using RenderMode.InteractiveServer in Blazor, OnInitializedAsync() is called twice during a page reload: once during the initial prerendering phase and once after establishing the server connection.
